methodology_note: Custom manifold specs & 3D CFD values come directly from CAD solids and verify_airflow.py. OEM Focus SVT/ST170 DSI values represent physics-modeled estimates based on documented runner/drum architecture (no laser scan of OEM clamshell on file). Real car telemetry points are taken from reports/2026-11-06-v037-iat-thermal-and-power-review.md.

oem_upper_dsi.material: Molded PA66-GF30 Plastic Clamshell (2M5Z-9424-BB) + IMRC Cable/Box
oem_upper_dsi.imrc_drum_and_shaft_seals: Vibration-welded NA seams + 2x rotary drum shaft seals (common boost leak source)
oem_upper_dsi.vac_boost_reference_ports: Shared OEM tee fittings (requires aftermarket vac block)
oem_upper_dsi.iacv_metering: Integrated to OEM upper molding; recirculated internally

custom_stage2_round.material: Annealed PPA-CF / PAHT-CF (3D Printed 2-Piece Split) + Epoxy Exterior Seal
custom_stage2_round.imrc_drum_and_shaft_seals: Deleted (0 rotating shafts; dual Viton O-rings + 2x dowels)
custom_stage2_round.vac_boost_reference_ports: 5 dedicated NPT pads (3x boost/vac + 2x check-valved vac-only)
custom_stage2_round.iacv_metering: OEM 2-bolt Ford IACV with isolated 1/4 NPT blow-through MAF supply barb
